structural_mapping.intermediate_variable: customer absorption or utilization together with realized price or spread

mismatch_dimensions: The target is an upstream solar-glass supplier; its customer interface, product mix, technology and funding carriers cannot be inherited from Longi.

application_rule.when_to_apply: Use only to order target research once a target solar-glass responsibility boundary and cutoff-visible carriers are identified.
application_rule.when_not_to_apply: Stop at a local conditional treatment when group cash, aggregate volume or commissioning substitutes for the target product economics and cash carriers.

invalidation_conditions.condition: The target bridge cannot be constructed under a compatible responsibility boundary or the recovery rival explains the carriers better.
invalidation_conditions.effect: Keep the capacity treatment conditional; do not infer enterprise failure or validate transfer.

strongest_near_miss.unknown_reason: No registered sealed-target near-miss with the same solar-glass responsibility boundary has been independently accepted.
strongest_near_miss.conservative_treatment: Question-only support; the card cannot support a central path or a valuation treatment.
